## Goal
Update instruction files and wire check-verifier-verdict.sh + check-manifest-completeness.sh into sprint Phase G epic-closure as hard errors. Conduct exhaustive consumer audit for overall_verdict references.

## Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/agents/completion-verifier.md: add P1 field (enum PASS|FAIL|BLOCKED|INCONCLUSIVE) to output schema; add narrative template field; keep overall_verdict with sunset TODO comment pointing to P1
- plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md: in Phase G epic-closure, after verifier dispatch: (1) call check-verifier-verdict.sh — non-zero exit = hard error, halt sprint; (2) call check-manifest-completeness.sh — non-zero exit = hard error; emit clear error message
- plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/SKILL.md: update any overall_verdict references to read P1 instead
- plugins/dso/skills/end-session/SKILL.md: update any overall_verdict references to read P1 instead
- plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/SKILL.md: update any overall_verdict references to read P1 instead

## Consumer Audit (exhaustiveness)
Run: grep -r 'overall_verdict' plugins/dso/skills/ plugins/dso/agents/ plugins/dso/scripts/
Confirm zero unupdated references after task completes (all occurrences either migrated to P1 or tagged with sunset TODO).

## Done Definitions Coverage
- DD1 (typed enum field): completion-verifier.md output schema updated with P1 field
- DD2 (check-verifier-verdict.sh): wired into Phase G sprint SKILL.md as hard error
- DD3 (check-manifest-completeness.sh): wired into Phase G sprint SKILL.md as hard error
- DD4 (self-application): DEFERRED to S11 (684d-ed77-c6ce-442b); this task explicitly does NOT include self-application

## Acceptance Criteria
- grep -c 'P1' plugins/dso/agents/completion-verifier.md → ≥1 (P1 field added)
- grep -c 'check-verifier-verdict' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md → ≥1 (wired in Phase G)
- grep -c 'check-manifest-completeness' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md → ≥1 (wired in Phase G)
- grep -r 'overall_verdict' plugins/dso/skills/ plugins/dso/agents/ | grep -v 'sunset\|TODO\|DEPRECATED' → 0 lines (all migrated or sunset-tagged)
- bash tests/scripts/test-check-verifier-verdict.sh exits 0 (still GREEN)
- bash tests/scripts/test-check-manifest-completeness.sh exits 0 (still GREEN)
- bash tests/scripts/test-verifier-integration.sh exits 0 (still GREEN)

## Testing Mode
GREEN (instruction file updates — behavioral-testing-standard Rule 5; depends T2, T4, T5a)
